_comment: Model Brain knowledge base (agent/model_brain.py). One entry per model FAMILY, taken ONLY from the vendor's own formal publications (generation_config.json, model card, API docs) - every entry names its sources. Matching is a case-insensitive regular expression on the model name with any ':tag' and 'namespace/' removed; the FIRST match wins, so keep more specific patterns first. 'sampling' holds Ollama option names (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty, presence_penalty); an EMPTY sampling dict means the vendor says not to send sampling values at all, so the model's own defaults are used. 'sampling_no_thinking' (optional) is used when thinking is switched off. To support a new model add an entry here - no code change. Models with no entry are researched automatically (model_profiles.learned.json in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Tlamatini\model_brain) and otherwise use the model's own published defaults.

profiles.notes: generation_config.json: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 (no repetition penalty). Z.ai: return the historical reasoning_content with tool results to keep the reasoning coherent (interleaved thinking).
Model card: temperature = 1.0, top_p = 1.0 for local deployment. API docs: with tools, reasoning_content must be fully passed back in all subsequent requests.
Model card: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95 for best performance.

Model card: one standardized configuration for all use cases (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64). History keeps only final responses, except tool-call turns where thinking content should be preserved.

Model card: thinking mode temperature 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 / min_p 0 / presence 0 / repetition 1.0; non-thinking 0.7 / 0.8 / 20 / 0 / presence 1.5 / 1.0. Historical output keeps only the final answer (the chat template does this).
README: We recommend sampling with temperature=1.0 and top_p=1.0. Harmony guide: drop previous chain-of-thought after a final answer, EXCEPT tool calling - pass it back for subsequent sampling.

Moonshot docs: temperature is not modifiable for the thinking models - use the default and do not pass it; K3 is tuned only through reasoning_effort. In tool-call loops keep every reasoning_content and send it back as-is.
Model card: use a temperature below 0.1 for daily-driver and production environments; keep the tool set small and well defined.
Model card and generation_config.json: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 for reasoning on, reasoning off and tool calling.
